Implemented by vote through the High Council of the Elseyran Defense Union, the following resolution (R. 2028-2) is adopted in response to the asset seizures and transfers conducted by the United Lavian Republic. By the Resolution on the Actions of the Lavian Government, all EDU states shall impose an embargo on the ULR and freeze Lavian assets held in EDU territories.

[b][u]Announcement From the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/u][/b]

The government of Fereydun Shah of Dhornaper will not be enforcing the sanctions against ULR as it has the right to do so under the EDU charter.

[B][i]5.2 No member shall be forced to participate in military actions or economic policies that contradict its national interest, unless such participation is deemed essential for the collective defense of the EDU, as determined by the Defense Althing.[/i][/b]

Such sanctions against ULR are fundamentally contradictory towards our national interest. Therefore, such a decision, per the EDU's charter, remains within the remit of EDU members unless a separate vote confirms this as essential for collective defence which the EDU has not done. As such, we invoke our right to national sovereignty over this economic issue and refuse to enforce these sanctions as we are permitted to by the organisation, without prejudice. Furthermore, we have not been sanctioned by ULR and neither has Corzzeran, Koranvistan, nor the United States of Oceanice as each of us did not enforce the previous sanctions against Vespurias, which similarly were not declared to be essential for the EDU.

We reiterate, per our last statement, that Wuloosya, who was the Neue Republik's cobelligerent against Rosenmarkke, has also not enacted any such sanctions against Vespurias nor ULR, neither of whom were belligerents in the conflict. Therefore, we question the need for such sanctions, which have been carried out for the interests of Wuloosya, a non-EDU member and aggressor in the war against Rosenmarkke. As the EDU is a defensive alliance, such actions being carried out in the name of the alliance call into question the alliance's purpose.

Signed,
Jalayer Khan, Minister of Foreign Affairs

[b][u]The Delegation replies[/u][/b]
The lead delegate from the NBE has changed to a tall, bearded and well dressed man named as "Lord H" who replies to the Chancellor in a candid way;

"Chancellor, you must realise that the sinking of the HMS Godiva is not reflective upon our Empire. The man responsible, Mr Glenn Quagmire is locked up in some prison on a floating prison ship south of Argos. You and your people have nothing to worry about. Afterall, our remaining "pleasure ships" have been sanitised and converted into luxury 'exploration' ships meaning that they are essentially a combination of a floating museum, international hotel and a carnival if that makes sense and we hope that at some point, your nation may accept and partake in this new kind of ship."

The rest of the Balionic delegation nod along with Lord H then saying; "Now. Let's get back to topic. What do you think of our plans? We understand that your nation requires many things that our Empire can help supply"[/quote]

[i]"For an Empire at war you have some, interesting requests."[/i] The Chancellor looks down at the sheet of paper in his hand, which bears all the notations of Balionic requests, both standard and unnatural. He points at words on the paper, as if to add more gravitas to his words. [i]"You wish to usurp Iroccoan sovereignty by proclaiming yourself a protector of Christians in the lands of the Sealiphate? Of tourists, workers and our own native Christian populace?"[/i] He placed the paper down, and stroked his beard, [i]"Other offers are acceptable, embassies, trade relations, permissibility of immigration. All natural, but this previous offer, it is simply unacceptable."[/i] The Chancellor adjusted his seating, perhaps to raise his presence.

[i]"The Sealiphate is not some backwater your Empire conquered in its glory days, Lord H."[/i]

Dr Indy Jones then returns the handshake, albeit by bending down.

"It is a pleasure meeting you Cartorous, though I wish we were not called milk drinkers as told by our translator we hired and that we should have took the train instead of this crapheap of a ship" he states slightly frustrated.

He then goes on to say, "We were told about your peoples all the way from the other end of Erene and we wish to further know and study your peoples much more indepthy, possibly the most indepth it's ever been. We want to know everything, so that greater recognition from the wider world can be brought to your peoples" 

Calls are then made to the bridge of the steamer to dock at the nearest harbour and the plan is to follow the Thaynguard towards his homeland and peoples. Before that happens, the expedition team manages to already document the local wildlife and environment they have so far seen along the river Dirja, along with demographic studies of the normal Iroccon people.[/quote]
[i]"A milkerdrinker is a milkdriker until the milk-covered sot earns a new title, and by my estimations. You have [u]not.[/u] Eitherway, your cause seems of interest to my Thayn. Come along, follow me and the bird here, we'll take you to him."[/i] He places his helmet back on, gives the Iroccoan a friendly tap and flies off.[/spoiler]

[b]Making a fort out of a city - October 1st, 1953[/b]

[i]It's 1953, and a civil war has gripped Sabrata. A disorganized force of royalists loyal to the House of al-Mahdin and a loose democratic coalition have dismissed their differences to fight against the socialist rebels commanded by General al-Sharif, but the situation looks grim. 
Lavian high command has decided that the city of Stikada, housing the Sabratan-Lavian Joint Airbase, shall serve as a buffer between the advancing socialists and a major sea port in Lavian territory. This is the beginning of the longest modern siege in history, one marked by artillery, airstrikes, and the most extensive trench defence network since 1921. This is the Siege of Stikada.

 Throughout the late morning sky, a Huxly CL-347 rumbles over the invisible line marking the border between the ULR and Sabrata. Inside it are the soldiers of the 96th Engineer Platoon, these men will soon be joining others like them in construction military installations, bunkers, and trenches which will last them for decades, which will see them and many others fight, kill, and die inside their walls. But at this time, they are floating through the sky without a care in the world.[/i]

As Jess is about to fall asleep to the hum of the engines, he hears Think the girls there will be nice? asked from right next to him.

Is that all you think about Monte? Youve thought of nothing else on this entire trip. 

Monte rolls his eyes and pulls a pack of cigarettes from one of his uniform pockets, smiling a little. Listen man, my dad was a bomber pilot stationed out of New Westmore, and let me tell you his stories got me hopeful. Cig?

You know I dont smoke. I got candy ones though. replied Jess.

The man across the isle from them pipes up. Ill take it if he wont. 

Monte moves his rifle aside and hands one to the guy. Already smoked through all yours Du-Hoc?

Du-Hoc pockets the cigarette and smiles. I visited Sabrata with family years ago, and these guys smoke more than you can imagine. Now that they got a war going on, I bet these will be worth enough for something better than whatever rations the army is gonna serve us.

Monte nods in agreement. Damn right. Light? 

Im saving this one for when we land. Du-Hoc replies.

Your loss

[i]While the group chats, the aircraft begins to descend and line up for a landing, finally touching down on a runway within the Sabrati-Lavian Joint Airbase, showing the troops inside the first glimpse of a city they will become quite familiar with in the coming years.  The platoon unloads their equipment and few personal items they brought and wait in the shade of a hangar till transport trucks come to pick them up. Quickly getting loaded into trucks, they have yet another wait until finally reaching their destination just outside the city: a dusty, undeveloped area populated with tents and halfway finished buildings. 

Many of the men looked a little disappointed in their lodging, however they had to put their cares aside and get some rest, as they would begin their construction assignments after the sun went down. Each tent fit four men and their belongings, serving as an island of shade against the sun. 

The assignments were never ending, jumping from one project just finished to starting up a new one as soon as possible. From barracks to command buildings to fortifications, all were being worked on. By the second week, a military base had practically sprung up from the ground. The airfield, which was assigned to the 41st and 2nd Engineer Companies saw similar growth as well. The remaining Sabratan soldiers were helping them build a mass stock of hangars, storage bunkers, another runway, as well as an entire new auxiliary airport. Nobody knew when or how enemy soldiers would come, but the entire city was tense, barely helped by the frequent troop convoy heading out establish the perimeter planned by Leonel Perrault. 25 miles away from the city in all directions, from the beaches bordering the Atlan Ocean to the border of the ULR, troops would dig in and prepare for the predicted fall of royalist forces in the south. [/i]

President Julian, influenced by the defense contractors' wishes to begin importing Wuloosyan weapons abroad for more cash flow, orders the State Department and War Department to begin formulating an offer to the country. The War Department is willing to transfer 5 of its Quasartico M30 HGVLs to the country, as Quasartico was already planning 10 more deliveries for the army later this year, and thus, the temporary loss of these systems wouldn't be devastating. The WDF can, however, offer, in far greater numbers, ATACMS Missiles, around a hundred that the army had been stockpiling, along with the 20 Quasartico M2AMS required to launch the system, and around 300 medium-range ballistic missiles and their accompanying launchers. These missiles had a range of around 2,000 km and were relatively cheap to produce. They had proved to be of great effectiveness during the war with Rosenmarkkee. To sweeten the deal, a guarantee of discounted reloads for the systems in the future would be made. In return, Wuloosya requested semiconductors from Acoysia to supplement future military and infrastructure development plans. Along with investments in the Ascoiyan economy to be held by the National Bank of Wuloosya. Once formulated, the offer would be sent through the Wuloosyan Embassy in Vespurias. [/quote]

[quote=lyuongo;61639645][pre]FRIDAY, 9th OF JUNE, 2028[/pre]
[i]Over the dark, damp jungle on the approach to Durgo, pillars of fire bloomed like vibrant flowers in the dead of night. LNSA forces had made their move towards the LNA-occupied city of Durgo in response to the ealier bombing raid of the city by the Lyuongo Air Force. Rushing to their humvees, the men of the Durgo branch of the Lyuongo Rapid Support Forces grabbed their black rifles and their sleeveless-camoflauge jackets before heading out to the National Highway. Small LNA contingents were already spread among the jungle heading up to Durgo, and they would be the first ones to meet LNSA forces in close quarters combat in charred nonite villages. Human soldiers used nonite corpses as all sorts of things... for cover, to set up traps for incoming enemy vehicles, their hides as jackets once the rain came in late into the night... As for the Highway, the scrambled rapid response forces skidded their humvees across the wet pavement, setting up a front using their armored vehicles. Behinf the humvees, the men of the RSF set up positions with their rifles and on the roof of the humvees, their .50 cal machine guns. Stalemate washed over the fighting, with the deep mud in the jungle making any advances pass the burnt villages all but impossible, and the no-mans-land of scattered bullets over the highway turned anyone daring enough to advance into hamburger. Both Air forces occupied each other over the air in Durgo, with the republican air force vehemetly defending the area around the Durgo Air Base.[/i][/quote]
Damn it all, Hein's initial rapid advance was stalled, his men were dying in waaaaay to large numbers for his soul to be comfortable with, and furthermore, the rain won't stop. Its slamming against the metal might finally render him insane. But he was a sane man yet! He ordered the swiftest rider in his army to make way to corporate mercenary captains in civilian clothing, posing as whatever they'd listen to, the rider would offer a bribe, some money up front and more after services rendered. The services, of course, hit the LNA from behind. Whether they would listen is another story, but Hein felt he could make a very convincing [i]"argument"[/i]

Hein couldn't make contact with the Northern Assault Force, thanks to those damn islanders. They continued to burn the non-humans and fight any LNA soldiers they came across. Continuing their attempts to take the Durgo from the hands of the Bastard forces. It was the gate to the Republic Northern Command, and would allow him to free up forces to crush the cowering-corpo-owned President bastard who fired him a week or two or maybe three now ago, he couldn't really remember, war shifts your perspective of time. 

He could, however, converse with those on the highway. It wasn't doing good, he and them knew it. He pulled back a couple hundred hundred metres, to a position where they wouldn't be hammered by a hailstorm of bullets, only by artillery shells! How wonderful! Though their new-age cannons would likewise roar back. If the LNA was smart enough to USE artillery here anyway.
